build_dpg_loss: build a deterministic policy gradient loss for continuous action spaces with optional gradient clipping
create_policy_gradient_loss: create a policy gradient loss using logits, actions, advantages, and per-timestep weights
compute_clipped_surrogate_pg_loss: compute a clipped surrogate policy gradient loss for proximal policy optimization
calculate_entropy_loss: calculate an entropy regularization loss from action logits and per-timestep weights
compute_qpg_loss: compute a Q-based policy gradient loss from action logits and action values
